Registered nurse and LPN jobs, posted pay as of 2026-10-19: typical $40 to $80/hr, median $45/hr (from 21,465 distinct posted hourly rates at 515 employers; 70,317 of the 97,460 open jobs post no hourly rate).
The employers posting the most for it (median of their own open jobs' posted rates, at least 8 rates each): 1. The Helper Bees [the-helper-bees] $125/hr (typical $125/hr, 17 open jobs); 2. Stanford Health Care [stanford-health-care] $105/hr (typical $100 to $115/hr, 34 open jobs); 3. UCSF Health [ucsf-health] $105/hr (typical $105 to $130/hr, 37 open jobs); 4. MarinHealth [marinhealth] $105/hr (typical $100 to $120/hr, 19 open jobs); 5. Sutter Health [sutter-health] $95/hr (typical $85 to $125/hr, 240 open jobs); 6. Alameda Health System [alameda-health-system] $90/hr (typical $85 to $125/hr, 46 open jobs); 7. UW Medicine [uw-medicine] $85/hr (typical $85 to $95/hr, 63 open jobs); 8. Montage Health [montage-health] $85/hr (typical $85 to $110/hr, 14 open jobs); 9. Salinas Valley Health [salinas-valley-health] $80/hr (typical $80 to $105/hr, 21 open jobs); 10. Southcoast Health System [southcoast-health-system] $80/hr (typical $65 to $80/hr, 66 open jobs).
Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/nurses#pay. These jobs by pay: https://carejobs.now/?work=nurses&sort=pay&country=all#live-roles. Typical pay is the 25th percentile of what jobs pay (the middle of each advertised range) to the 90th-percentile advertised ceiling. Method: https://carejobs.now/methodology.
